title: Dasakam 64 — Govindapaṭṭābhiṣekam
description: Krishna is recognized as the Lord of the universe: Indra and Surabhi honor him, Gokula flourishes, and Krishna reveals Vaikuntha to the cowherds.
translation_note: No vetted English verse translation was supplied or added; translation_en remains empty. The supplied photo captions are preserved as attributed commentary, not translations.

stanzas.sanskrit:
आलोक्य शैलोद्धरणादिरूपं
प्रभावमुच्चैस्तव गोपलोकाः ।
विश्वेश्वरं त्वामभिमत्य विश्वे
नन्दं भवज्जातकमन्वपृच्छन् ॥ ६४-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ālokya śailoddharaṇādirūpaṃ
prabhāvamuccaistava gopalokāḥ |
viśveśvaraṃ tvāmabhimatya viśve
nandaṃ bhavajjātakamanvapṛcchan || 64-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: After seeing several victories of Krishna including lifting of Govardhana mountains, Gopas considered Krishna as the Lord of the Universe. They asked Nandagopan to check Krishna's horoscope to know the facts.

stanzas.sanskrit:
गर्गोदितो निर्गदितो निजाय
वर्गाय तातेन तव प्रभावः ।
पूर्वाधिकस्त्वय्यनुराग एषा-
-मैधिष्ट तावद्बहुमानभारः ॥ ६४-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
gargodito nirgadito nijāya
vargāya tātena tava prabhāvaḥ |
pūrvādhikastvayyanurāga eṣā-
-maidhiṣṭa tāvadbahumānabhāraḥ || 64-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Nandagopan happily shared what Sage Garga has predicted about Krishna's glory, when Krishna was an infant. This made the Gopas show greater respect and love to Him than before.

stanzas.sanskrit:
ततोऽवमानोदिततत्त्वबोधः
सुराधिराजः सह दिव्यगव्या ।
उपेत्य तुष्टाव स नष्टगर्वः
स्पृष्ट्वा पदाब्जं मणिमौलिना ते ॥ ६४-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tato’vamānoditatattvabodhaḥ
surādhirājaḥ saha divyagavyā |
upetya tuṣṭāva sa naṣṭagarvaḥ
spṛṣṭvā padābjaṃ maṇimaulinā te || 64-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Indra, head of devas, understood his mistake and came down to earth with his divine cow, Kamadenu. With his pride shattered, Indra put down his crowned head at the lotus feet of Krishna and sang his praises.

stanzas.sanskrit:
स्नेहस्नुतैस्त्वां सुरभिः पयोभि-
-र्गोविन्दनामाङ्कितमभ्यषिञ्चत् ।
ऐरावतोपाहृतदिव्यगङ्गा-
-पाथोभिरिन्द्रोऽपि च जातहर्षः ॥ ६४-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
snehasnutaistvāṃ surabhiḥ payobhi-
-rgovindanāmāṅkitamabhyaṣiñcat |
airāvatopāhṛtadivyagaṅgā-
-pāthobhirindro’pi ca jātaharṣaḥ || 64-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
The divine cow Kamadenu with deep flowing love for Krishna, did Abhishekam with its milk, giving the name Govinda to Krishna, the Lord of cows.
Iraavata the elephant of Indra brought the waters of the holy Ganga and Indra also did abhishekam to Bhagwan delightfully.

stanzas.sanskrit:
जगत्त्रयेशे त्वयि गोकुलेशे
तथाऽभिषिक्ते सति गोपवाटः ।
नाकेऽपि वैकुण्ठपदेऽप्यलभ्यां
श्रियं प्रपेदे भवतः प्रभावात् ॥ ६४-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
jagattrayeśe tvayi gokuleśe
tathā’bhiṣikte sati gopavāṭaḥ |
nāke’pi vaikuṇṭhapade’pyalabhyāṃ
śriyaṃ prapede bhavataḥ prabhāvāt || 64-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna is the Bhagwan for the three worlds. Gokulam attained prosperity equivalent to Vaikuntam due to Krishna's grace and glory.

stanzas.sanskrit:
कदाचिदन्तर्यमुनं प्रभाते
स्नायन् पिता वारुणपूरुषेण ।
नीतस्तमानेतुमगाः पुरीं त्वं
तां वारुणीं कारणमर्त्यरूपः ॥ ६४-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kadācidantaryamunaṃ prabhāte
snāyan pitā vāruṇapūruṣeṇa |
nītastamānetumagāḥ purīṃ tvaṃ
tāṃ vāruṇīṃ kāraṇamartyarūpaḥ || 64-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Once when Nandagopan went to river Yamuna for bathing, an asura, a servant of Varuna took away Nandagopan to Varuna loka. Krishna who came to earth in human form to kill the evil, went to Varuna loka to bring his father back.

stanzas.sanskrit:
ससम्भ्रमं तेन जलाधिपेन
प्रपूजितस्त्वं प्रतिगृह्य तातम् ।
उपागतस्तत्क्षणमात्मगेहं
पिताऽवदत् तच्चरितं निजेभ्यः ॥ ६४-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sasambhramaṃ tena jalādhipena
prapūjitastvaṃ pratigṛhya tātam |
upāgatastatkṣaṇamātmagehaṃ
pitā’vadat taccaritaṃ nijebhyaḥ || 64-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The Lord of the waters, Varuna, was  surprised at Bhagwan’s unexpected appearance. Varuna begged sorry for the servant's mistake. Krishna returned with his father to Gokulam immediately. Nandagopan narrated the incident to the Gopas.

stanzas.sanskrit:
हरिं विनिश्चित्य भवन्तमेतान्
भवत्पदालोकनबद्धतृष्णान् ।
निरीक्ष्य विष्णो परमं पदं त-
-द्दुरापमन्यैस्त्वमदीदृशस्तान् ॥ ६४-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
hariṃ viniścitya bhavantametān
bhavatpadālokanabaddhatṛṣṇān |
nirīkṣya viṣṇo paramaṃ padaṃ ta-
-ddurāpamanyaistvamadīdṛśastān || 64-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The gopas now firmly believed that Krishna is Lord Hari himself and requested Him to show Vaikuntam. The state of supreme bliss, form of Bhagwan in Vaikuntam which is not attainable easily was shown to Gopas.

stanzas.sanskrit:
स्फुरत्परानन्दरसप्रवाह-
-प्रपूर्णकैवल्यमहापयोधौ ।
चिरं निमग्नाः खलु गोपसङ्घा-
-स्त्वयैव भूमन् पुनरुद्धृतास्ते ॥ ६४-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sphuratparānandarasapravāha-
-prapūrṇakaivalyamahāpayodhau |
ciraṃ nimagnāḥ khalu gopasaṅghā-
-stvayaiva bhūman punaruddhṛtāste || 64-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The great ocean of liberation was complete and overflowing with blissful nectar. Gopas soaked in that ocean for a very long time and were brought back to the conscious world later by Krishna.

stanzas.sanskrit:
करबदरवदेवं देव कुत्रावतारे
निजपदमनवाप्यं दर्शितं भक्तिभाजाम् ।
तदिह पशुपरूपी त्वं हि साक्षात् परात्मा
पवनपुरनिवासिन् पाहि मामामयेभ्यः ॥ ६४-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
karabadaravadevaṃ deva kutrāvatāre
nijapadamanavāpyaṃ darśitaṃ bhaktibhājām |
tadiha paśuparūpī tvaṃ hi sākṣāt parātmā
pavanapuranivāsin pāhi māmāmayebhyaḥ || 64-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: No other incarnation revealed Bhagwan's Vaikuntam to the devotees easily, but only in Krishna incarnation, when he came as a cowherd boy, the unattainable abode was revealed to devotees clearly like a gooseberry in one's palm. Bhattathiri worshipped Bhagwan and requested to protect him from his afflictions.
